Meta Test Description: The testcase performs PCIe device enumeration across two dual-mode controllers (DM0 and DM1). It begins by writing 0x0 to 0xE6004100 to initialize the system. It then invokes link training (link_training_dm0_x4 or link_training_dm1_x4) based on compile-time defines (DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP). Cache coherency programming is performed by reading mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF and mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, modifying specific bit fields using set_data at bit positions [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], and [19:22] with value 0xf, and writing back. A wait_on(20) delay is inserted between coherency programming phases. The test then polls read_sii0_reg(0xC0) in a while loop until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1, and similarly polls read_sii1_reg(0xC0) for the same link-up condition. Under DM0_RC, the Vendor ID is read from read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0), the command register is written via write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4, 0x7) to enable IO, Memory, and Bus Master, and memory base programming functions mem_base_program_dm0_x4 and mem_base_program_dm1_x4 are called. System-level registers at 0xE690000C, 0xE6900010, 0xE6900014, 0xE6900018, 0xE6900030, and 0xE6900034 are written with 0x1. Cache coherency is then disabled by writing 0x0 to bit fields [19:22] and [27:30] of both COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF registers. After a wait_on(30), BAR sizing is performed on the endpoint via write_pcie_slv1_reg and read_pcie_slv1_reg for offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1c, 0x20, 0x24 by writing 0xFFFFFFFF, reading back, then writing actual base addresses. The same BAR sizing sequence is repeated for slv0. Finally, the test polls 0xE6004100 in a while loop until the value equals 0x12345678, then calls finish(0).
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Write 0x0 to 0xE6004100 to initialize the system. 2. Invoke link_training_dm0_x4(4) or link_training_dm1_x4(4) based on compile-time defines (DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP). 3. Enable cache coherency: read mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, use set_data to modify bits [11:14] and [3:6] to 0xf, write back. 4. Read mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF again, modify bits [27:30] and [19:22] to 0xf, write back. 5. Repeat steps 3-4 for mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. 6. Call wait_on(20). 7. Read mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, set bits [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], [19:22] all to 0xf, write back. 8. Read mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, set bits [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], [19:22] all to 0xf, write back. 9. Read read_sii0_reg(0xC0) and poll in while loop until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1. 10. Read read_sii1_reg(0xC0) and poll in while loop until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1. 11. Call non_secure_prot_nic(). 12. Under DM0_RC: read Vendor ID via read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0) and print. 13. Write 0x7 to write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4) to enable IO, Memory, Bus Master. 14. Call mem_base_program_dm0_x4() and mem_base_program_dm1_x4(). 15. Call wait_on(10). 16. Write 0x1 to system registers 0xE690000C, 0xE6900010, 0xE6900014, 0xE6900018, 0xE6900030, 0xE6900034. 17. Disable cache: read mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, modify bits [19:22] and [27:30] to 0x0, write back. 18. Repeat step 17 for mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. 19. Call wait_on(10), then repeat disable with all four bit fields cleared for both controllers. 20. Call wait_on(30). 21. BAR sizing on slv1: write 0xFFFFFFFF to offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1c, 0x20, 0x24 via write_pcie_slv1_reg, read back each via read_pcie_slv1_reg. 22. Write actual base addresses to slv1. 23. Read back slv1 offsets 0x10-0x24. 24. Repeat BAR sizing and programming for slv0. 25. Call wait_on(10). 26. Poll 0xE6004100 in while loop until value equals 0x12345678. 27. Call finish(0).

Meta Test Description: The testcase performs PCIe DMA write and read operations across four channels on either DM0 or DM1 controller. It begins by writing 0x0 to 0xE6004100 to initialize the system. Link training is invoked based on compile-time defines. Under DM0_RC, the test polls read_sii0_reg(0xC0) until link-up. The Vendor ID is read via read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0). The command register is written via write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4, 0x7). BAR and memory base programming is performed. Source memory is preloaded with 0xC0DEBEED and 0xF00DDEAF patterns. DMA interrupts are unmasked via mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_WRITE_INT_MASK_OFF and mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_READ_INT_MASK_OFF. Four DMA write channels are triggered via mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_WRITE_DOORBELL_OFF, followed by four DMA read channels via mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_READ_DOORBELL_OFF. The IRQ handler reads mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_WRITE_INT_STATUS_OFF and mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_READ_INT_STATUS_OFF, clears via mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_WRITE_INT_CLEAR_OFF and mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_READ_INT_CLEAR_OFF. Under DM1_RC, PCIE1 variants are used.

Write 0x7 to write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4). 6. Program BARs and memory base. 7. Call non_secure_prot_nic(). 8. Poll 0xE6004100 until 0x12345678. 9. Preload source memory. 10. Enable GIC interrupts. 11. Write 0x0 to mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_WRITE_INT_MASK_OFF and mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_READ_INT_MASK_OFF. 12-15. Program and trigger DMA write channels 0-3 via mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_WRITE_DOORBELL_OFF. 16-19. Program and trigger DMA read channels 0-3 via mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_READ_DOORBELL_OFF. 20. IRQ handler reads mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_WRITE_INT_STATUS_OFF and mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_READ_INT_STATUS_OFF. 21. Clears via mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_WRITE_INT_CLEAR_OFF and mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_DMA_READ_INT_CLEAR_OFF. 22. Call finish(0).

Meta Test Description: The testcase performs PCIe memory write and read operations through the PCIe slave interface on either DM0 or DM1 controller in root complex or endpoint mode. It begins by writing 0x0 to 0xE6004100 to initialize the system. Cache coherency programming is performed on mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF and mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. The test polls read_sii0_reg(0xC0) or read_sii1_reg(0xC0) for link-up. The Vendor ID is read via read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0) or read_pcie_slv1_reg(0x0). The command register is written via write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4, 0x7) or write_pcie_slv1_reg(0x4, 0x7). After disabling cache coherency, memory write-read operations are performed via pcie_slv0_mem_wr_rd() or pcie_slv1_mem_wr_rd() at multiple offsets. The test polls 0xE6004100 until 0x12345678, then calls finish(0).
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Write 0x0 to 0xE6004100. 2. Invoke link training. 3. Enable cache coherency on mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF and mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. 4. Call wait_on(20). 5. Poll read_sii0_reg(0xC0) or read_sii1_reg(0xC0) for link-up. 6. Read Vendor ID via read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0). 7. Write 0x7 to write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4). 8. Program BARs and memory base. 9. Call non_secure_prot_nic(). 10. Write 0x11111111 to 0xE6004100. 11. Disable cache coherency in two phases. 12. Call wait_on(30). 13. Perform memory write-read operations. 14. Poll 0xE6004100 until 0x12345678. 15. Call finish(0).

Meta Test Description: The testcase performs register reset value verification and read-write validation across three categories of PCIe registers: DBI controller registers, SII registers, and PHY registers for both PCIE0 and PCIE1 controllers. Five DBI controller register addresses are stored in rc0_ctl_addr[] and rc1_ctl_addr[] arrays. Three SII register addresses are stored in sii0_addr[] and sii1_addr[] arrays. Three PHY register addresses are stored in phy0_addr[] and phy1_addr[] arrays. The chk_rst_val() function reads all registers and compares against expected default values. The chk_rd_wr() function performs write-read verification using three test patterns. Errors are accumulated in err1 and err2 counters. The test concludes with finish(err2 || err1).
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Call chk_rst_val() for reset value verification. 2. Read rc0_ctl_addr[] and rc1_ctl_addr[] registers and compare against defaults. 3. Read sii0_addr[] and sii1_addr[] registers and compare against defaults. 4. Write mizar_PCIE0_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL and mizar_PCIE1_SII_PHY_RST_CONTROL with 0x01203000. 5. Read phy0_addr[] and phy1_addr[] with 16-bit extraction and compare against defaults. 6. Call chk_rd_wr() for write-read verification. 7. For each of 3 test patterns, write to all register arrays. 8. Read back and compare all registers. 9. Call finish(err2 || err1).
